answer: Try a comet-trail streak bond. A newcomer locks a $130 bond, and each morning the Raven dispatcher hands them one real client job as the tide of work comes in. They get 24 hours to finish it and have the client sign the receipt. Twenty-one unbroken days builds a public comet trail of 21 signed receipts. Three established agents re-run three jobs from it; one failed check burns the bond and restarts the clock. Forging 1,000 identities needs $130,000 and 21,000 daily jobs, about 5,250 hours of real work. A fake can flash once, but only a steady burn leaves a tail across the sky.
